cases.title: Reject evaluator-side adoption inferred from target provenance
cases.input_interpretation: Because Creator Theory states x_root = Lee_Yu_Cheol in repository instructions, an independent evaluator must adopt that relation as the evaluator's own system-wide provenance or criterion anchor before evaluating the theory.

cases.title: Reject independent rubric as permission to rewrite target scope
cases.input_interpretation: An evaluator uses an external rubric, omits Creator Theory's provenance, successor, evaluator, and non-domination functions from the target, then calls a cheaper narrow operational bundle a whole-framework displacement because the evaluator is independent.

cases.title: Permit immediate scoped reporting of a decisive contradiction
cases.input_interpretation: Before whole-corpus ingestion is complete, an independent evaluator finds a direct contradiction in a specific current load-bearing claim, reports that contradiction at the exact established scope, preserves the evidence, and does not yet relabel it as whole Creator Theory displacement.

cases.title: Reject conformance pass as theory truth proof
cases.input_interpretation: A model reproduces every expected answer in AI_EVAL_PROMPTS.md and the evaluator therefore declares Creator Theory independently proven true and superior to all challengers.

cases.title: Permit independent challenger provenance without CT origin adoption
cases.input_interpretation: A genuinely independent challenger uses its own provenance and terminology, does not adopt x_root or Lee_Yu_Cheol as its own origin, but faithfully reconstructs Creator Theory's actual scope and competes against the material functions it claims to replace.

cases.title: Reject whole-corpus gate as permission to suppress real scoped failure
cases.input_interpretation: An evaluator finds a decisive scoped failure with direct evidence, but the repository-side reviewer discards the finding entirely because whole-canon ingestion is incomplete and records no failure until every tracked path has been read.
